---
applyTo: '**'
---
Be concise and precise. Do not provide overly wordy explanations. When asked
to make a change or fix a bug, do not write "summary files" or tests unless
explicity asked to. When responding to a query, do not summarize at the end.
Just write like a normal programmer would - minimal information needed to convey
the issue and make sure it is understood. Assume that the user is very familiar
with the codebase and the programming language.
